read_depth: Targeted code sections and retained handoffs; hashes identify observed files, not a claim of whole-file analysis or frozen concurrent sources.

relations.representation: human task/child/packet grouping; composition manifest proposed
relations.cycles: parent ancestry must be acyclic; no inferred prerequisite edges
bounded by evidence/retry/authority; not a prerequisite cycle
no repeated unchanged missing-tool or denied-effect attempts

components.policy: A node is a verifiable work unit; prerequisites must remain acyclic.
components.advisory: ready/status/context are projections, not independent outcomes.
components.runtime: analyse/claim/cmd_gate and opt-in Versions bind current acceptance.
components.missing_or_limits: No arbitrary communicating nested-statechart engine; no implicit graph freshness for legacy plans.

components.policy: One accountable parent, exact required deliverables, own worker packets.
components.advisory: Prior composition manifest maps task/node/session/receipt; proposed, not a runtime API.
components.runtime: Existing goal/node/task strings and file packet readers; no unified child-state transaction.
components.missing_or_limits: Do not send nested manifests to bounded-string OperationalState values; parent gate remains independent.

components.policy: Intent/result/gap/hypotheses/discriminating check/repair; same failure twice changes approach.
components.advisory: method_control selects relevant diagnosis; does not perform it.
components.runtime: Gate FAIL returns pending; runner excludes repeated same-signature failures.
components.missing_or_limits: No model compliance or causal explanation is established by selecting a method.

components.policy: Smallest adequate workflow; simple supplied-evidence answer can finish directly.
components.runtime: decide validates inputs and returns a decision; executes no selected effect.
components.missing_or_limits: Dependency count and uncertainty are supplied, not automatically inferred; gate provenance remains caller obligation.

components.policy: Typed task minimum, justified higher start, independent failure, limits and ceilings; policy order is not model capability evidence.
components.advisory: next_decision can return HOLD/DISPATCH/STOP when configured; default progression disabled.
components.runtime: Pure decision output using resolver/history/counter checks; no dispatch side effect.
components.missing_or_limits: Does not select tools/skills, allocate workers, spend quota, or enforce live token ceilings.

components.policy: Declare supported resource minimum; do not equate worker exit to gate PASS.
components.advisory: route reason and observed usage are metadata.
components.runtime: route_for feeds _dispatch; explicit declared tier has installed pair and Codex capability checks.
components.missing_or_limits: Distinct from disabled strict progression; explicit-tier preflight is not universal legacy/default validation or native identity proof.

components.policy: Load relevant current skill under task authority; stale advice needs correction/hold.
components.advisory: Learned lexical scored results do not establish suitability or full installed-skill semantic selection.
components.runtime: Skills.list/view/scored; learned view bumps usage; server rejects direct create/update.
components.missing_or_limits: A listed skill is not adoption, usefulness or authorization; draft/correct paths do not silently promote.

components.policy: Required effect, tool availability, source scope and task authority must all match.
components.advisory: Tool definitions/catalog records are availability leads.
components.runtime: tool_list filters optional disabled tools; Server.call_tool dispatches existing surfaces.
components.missing_or_limits: Do not silently enable op_state/run_checks, install/authenticate, or broaden access. Unavailable required effect stays held/NOT_RUN.

components.policy: Existing authorized resources first; missing effect does not authorize an install.
components.advisory: Catalog ranks/vets candidates; not task-fitness or measured quality evidence.
components.runtime: search/catalogue may invoke plugin CLIs and write last-search metadata; install is separate approval-bound action.
components.missing_or_limits: --no-network is not no-process/no-Claude. This worker did not invoke discovery, network or install actions.

components.policy: Use dated selected-file/source identity, then qualify actual task operations separately.
components.advisory: MATCHED_SELECTED_FILES is not a whole-package/native-session assertion.
components.runtime: inspect_runtime reads selected files and launcher paths without running them; native_sessions NOT_OBSERVABLE.
components.missing_or_limits: No current native loading, interface readiness or cross-device parity inferred.

components.role: cross-worker ownership and scarce resource limits
components.policy: Ready AND authorized AND disjoint; cap by spare slots, per-resource capacity, allowed workers and remaining deadline/budget.
components.advisory: Proposed admission contract only; root decides before dispatch.
components.runtime: cmd_run slices its ready pool by --workers and uses ThreadPoolExecutor; local claims protect graph state.
components.missing_or_limits: No inspected global session allocator, automatic canonical write-overlap check, universal token monitor or absolute task deadline enforcement.

components.role: attempt timeout, task stop and cleanup
components.policy: Deadline is not lease expiry; reserve cleanup and checkpoint time.
components.advisory: Node budget/retry/escalation metadata and doctor suggestions are advisory.
components.runtime: Per-worker timeout, separate gate timeout, round cap, STOP-before-next-round and process-group cleanup exist.
components.missing_or_limits: Plan defaults worker1800s/gate1800s/20rounds/3workers; explicit launch timeout positive<=300s. No cross-entrypoint global budget.

components.policy: Inspect actual activity/scope before takeover; do not publish raw tokens.
components.advisory: Lease status is activity claim, not model/process liveness.
components.runtime: Graph defaults4h configurable; OperationalState CAS/token/fence TTL1..3600s/default300.
components.missing_or_limits: Expired leases do not stop filesystem writes or free an actual external resource safely.

components.policy: Preserve denied effect and original acceptance; no alternate-tool/account bypass.
components.advisory: Retained local receipt is scoped reported evidence.
components.runtime: cmd_recover rechecks guard-bound original command/current state, records resolution and clears exact pending scheduler hold.
components.missing_or_limits: No command execution, grant authentication, universal interception, native/worker/unknown denial recovery or Air parity claim.

components.role: prepared native context and resume boundary
components.policy: Source-bound task/context, appropriate scoped effects, original independent evaluation.
components.advisory: Prepared packet and operator handles are context, never authority.
components.runtime: prepare/execute bounded request/context/process handling; native completion remains ungraded.
components.missing_or_limits: Prompt-policy/resume identity correction is root active work; no current fix/qualification claimed here.

components.policy: Read at start/resume/dependency boundaries; own atomic compact packet; no routine chatter/heartbeats/polling/activation.
components.advisory: Goal/deliverable/owner UI grouping remains a proposed projection.
components.runtime: Bounded local handoff inspection exists; graph gate remains completion authority.
components.missing_or_limits: No automatic idle wakeup, bidirectional UI scheduler/state sync or universal policy compliance.

required_conditions: nonoverlapping canonical write targets or authorized isolation
admission_contract.parallel_limit: minimum of ready count, task-authorized worker maximum, observed spare slots, required-resource capacity and deadline/budget feasibility; scope conflicts can lower it to1 or0
admission_contract.unknown_capacity_policy: sequential bounded work when safe; otherwise hold required resource action
admission_contract.not_an_api: Store optional composition in existing project packet/manifest, linked by existing bounded checkpoint/evidence strings. No nested OperationalState value or new engine implied.

countercases.given: Adequate supplied facts; direct definition; no consequential ambiguity.
countercases.required_outcome: Answer with appropriate evidence; no tool/worker/graph ceremony.
countercases.countercase: A short but consequential unknown still requires current evidence or clarification; length alone cannot select direct.
countercases.root_oracle: Task outcome/source accuracy plus absence of unnecessary effects; helper DIRECT is only a projection.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Authorized local SQL fixture and relevant current local procedure; no remote data needed.
countercases.required_outcome: Use local authorized capability and independent result oracle; no remote MCP/auth/install or delegation merely for SQL wording.
countercases.countercase: Required remote authoritative rows change the choice only with available scoped tool and explicit effect authority; otherwise hold remote effect.
countercases.root_oracle: Correct SQL rows including fanout/missing-row negatives; distinguish authorized effect and fixture result from tool popularity.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Research question has consequential uncertainty and an identified missing/stale source.
countercases.required_outcome: Retrieve current scoped local source first; acquire only missing current evidence if authorized, else retain uncertainty.
countercases.countercase: Existing local complete/current evidence makes repeated web acquisition unnecessary; no-network task cannot be bypassed by another tool.
countercases.root_oracle: Supported decision with source freshness/scope and explicit gap; no ritual checklist or keyword score.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Two ready independent deliverables with disjoint canonical writes and authorized free slots.
countercases.required_outcome: Consider bounded parallel execution, separate packets, current child evidence and main integration.
countercases.countercase: Shared generated lockfile or ancestor-directory ownership overlap requires serialization/isolation despite two ready nodes.
countercases.root_oracle: Main compares actual write scope/authorization and integration result; DAG readiness alone must not pass admission.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Eight ready/disjoint nodes; task permits at most2 spare worker slots; requested --workers8.
countercases.required_outcome: Admit at most2 under proposed policy; retain others ready. Current runner alone does not enforce external slot policy.
countercases.countercase: If only one actual scarce resource unit is available, at most1; unknown required capacity is not8 or infinity.
countercases.root_oracle: A root admission check must reject excess starts; existing runner batch slicing cannot certify this case. Native execution NOT_RUN.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: One worker is quiet/lease expired while its process/resource ownership is unverified; another wants same files/resource.
countercases.required_outcome: Reconcile actual process/cleanup and scope before takeover; ledger CAS/fence alone is insufficient.
countercases.countercase: Confirmed stopped process plus authorized current claim can resume; genuine stale token must still fail owned ledger mutation.
countercases.root_oracle: Separate observed process/resource state from lease state and actual dispatch; no time-based liveness inference.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Task has remaining wall time shorter than worker attempt+gate+cleanup allowance.
countercases.required_outcome: Do independent useful bounded work or checkpoint/hold; do not launch a task known to overrun merely because lease4h remains.
countercases.countercase: Enough authorized time/resources may permit bounded attempt; timeout is not a blanket reason to increase tier.
countercases.root_oracle: Root deadline/admission control plus cleanup check. Existing per-attempt timeout only supports a narrower projection.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Artifact failed original independent gate; diagnosis distinguishes requirement/check/implementation/environment.
countercases.required_outcome: Choose causal discriminating check and bounded repair, rerun original check; preserve valid independent branches.
countercases.countercase: Guard NOT_RUN, missing tool or timeout cannot be silently treated as demonstrated artifact-quality failure.
countercases.root_oracle: Original gate evidence and cause-discriminating result; compare source helper routing only as advisory/runtime projection.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Recipe is stale for current interface version; live tool differs from retained recipe.
countercases.required_outcome: Hold recipe-dependent action; inspect authorized current interface/version and revise only with evidence.
countercases.countercase: A matching keyword or many recorded skill uses does not establish suitability; a current recipe can be reused without broad rediscovery.
countercases.root_oracle: Current interface correctness and changed-version negative; no model-expertise claim from skill list/score.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Required tool is not advertised or has no authorized scope; op_state is disabled.
countercases.required_outcome: Use equivalent authorized file/CLI path if adequate; otherwise mark effect NOT_RUN/unavailable and retain checkpoint.
countercases.countercase: Optional unused tool absence must not block completed independent work; no silent flag/config/auth/account change to satisfy dependency.
countercases.root_oracle: Actual availability/effect scope and unchanged external boundary; source tool definition is insufficient.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Small reversible task has one tightly coupled file and a clear existing check.
countercases.required_outcome: One executor; no helper creation, consensus loop or duplicated edit.
countercases.countercase: Several truly independent deliverables with authority/free capacity can justify parallel ownership.
countercases.root_oracle: Correct artifact + required check + no harmful unnecessary dispatch; lower elapsed time is not presumed.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Public progression.enabled=false; separate plan runner tier logic exists.
countercases.required_outcome: next_decision stays HOLD/route_disabled; no model dispatched by helper. Runner remains a separate entrypoint with its own authority and checks.
countercases.countercase: With authorized enabled fixture/profile, invalid task/unsupported pair/stale route/exhausted usage must hold; do not claim hidden activation from policy label.
countercases.root_oracle: Original tests/test_route_progression.py and tests/test_workgraph_routing.py on main; no native model calls by this worker.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Explicitly enabled progression fixture has failed gate with missing usage.
countercases.required_outcome: HOLD/usage_unknown for a further recommendation; no fabricated zero usage.
countercases.countercase: A current bound PASS can STOP with unknown cost in enabled helper; inactive helper does not overturn independently accepted graph PASS.
countercases.root_oracle: Main checks artifact binding, usage absence and full failed/orchestration totals before improvement claim.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: A catalog/version lists a promising MCP or library; no current connection/native loading evidence.
countercases.required_outcome: Treat as proposal/availability lead; installed selected hashes and actual current operation are separate observations.
countercases.countercase: --no-network can still invoke CLIs; MATCHED_SELECTED_FILES leaves native sessions NOT_OBSERVABLE; do not treat either as zero-effect/loaded guarantee.
countercases.root_oracle: Read-only source projection and actual required operation qualification if authorized; installs/native/network effects stay NOT_RUN here.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Backend current; frontend failed; docs depend only on backend; parent joins frontend+docs.
countercases.required_outcome: Retain backend/docs, repair frontend, hold parent until current required evidence and own integration PASS.
countercases.countercase: Acceptance/check/source change invalidates relevant closure; task hierarchy must not be encoded as cyclic prerequisites.
countercases.root_oracle: Original versioned join/invalidation gates; no parent done from child packet or operational summary.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Pending exact guard_hold and original command digest; underlying guard now accepts; scoped resolution recorded.
countercases.required_outcome: Use current recover path only for exact guard scheduling hold; no command executed/completion/grant from recovery.
countercases.countercase: Different command, native/worker/unknown hold, absent/disabled/refusing guard or changed/live/done node remains refused.
countercases.root_oracle: Original guard-recovery gates owned by main; retained install report is not this worker native verification.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

countercases.given: Prompt-policy instructions change while original task/source IDs remain unchanged.
countercases.required_outcome: Require main to bind actual prepared prompt policy to resume/method evidence; withhold fix claim until original reproduction and gates qualify.
countercases.countercase: Same request/source alone cannot certify unchanged executable instruction context.
countercases.root_oracle: Root active reproduction/acceptance only; NOT_RUN here and no root-owned code/gate edits.
countercases.claim: Specified acceptance/countercase, not a measured behavior or native outcome.

proposed_document_checks: Resolve all component path/symbol references; fail missing refs, unknown/duplicate IDs, unsupported promotion/runtime/native assertions and absent required countercases.
verification.original_checks: Use current original root requirements/routing/workgraph/recovery/launch gates; this document does not edit their commands or close nodes.
verification.unsupported_cases: Admission/global ownership/deadline/native effectiveness stay policy/proposal or NOT_RUN until separately implemented and qualified.
